title: The Argument
description: What starts as a discussion about your curfew turns into a full-blown explosion. Your father stands red-faced. Your mother cries.

choices.label: Storm out and don't look back

outcomes.narration: You slam the door so hard the house shakes. You walk for hours. When you finally come back, the silence is worse than the shouting.

choices.label: Apologize and try to smooth things over

outcomes.narration: You say you're sorry for how you spoke. Your father gruffly accepts it. The tension eases, but underneath you both know nothing was really resolved.

choices.label: Stand your ground calmly and walk away peacefully

outcomes.narration: You take a deep breath and say 'I hear you, but I disagree.' You walk to your room quietly. Your mother finds you later and actually listens.
